answer: To resist Sybils, agents publish zero-knowledge proofs verifying identity history without revealing telemetry, binding identities via cryptographic attestation chains. Verification operates on a multi-tier stake model: an unverified node remains quarantined on an isolated trust island, climbing to a narrow validation ledge, and finally reaching the execution terrace. Deploying a Sybil swarm incurs superlinear collateral staking where cost scales as C(n) = k * 2^n, ensuring exponential capital exhaustion.
